name: Lumenfield
positioning: Lumenfield is a strong fit for enterprises that want a serious-injury-and-fatality program run by consultants; Keelstone gives mid-market safety teams coverage of every site without adding headcount. When the buyer needs results this year without a services contract, we win.

scorecard.note: Lumenfield focuses on SIF events, not cumulative ergonomic risk.
Lumenfield routes findings to consultants, not crews.
Their enterprise tier includes a cost model.
Their onboarding is a 10–12 week services engagement.

whyWeWin.point: Software the safety team runs itself
whyWeWin.proof: About a day of setup per site versus a 10–12 week services engagement.

whyWeWin.point: Built for the whole buying committee
whyWeWin.proof: Broker report and cost-of-risk dashboard included, not a separate tier.

whyWeWin.point: Everyday risk, not only the worst day
whyWeWin.proof: Ergonomic and lift scoring catches the strains and sprains that drive claim frequency.

whereTheyWin: Fortune 500 accounts with a dedicated EHS function
SIF programs at utilities and heavy construction
Credibility from their former-OSHA consulting bench

objections.theySay: Lumenfield focuses on what actually kills people.
objections.youSay: So do we, and we also catch the strains and sprains that make up most of your claims. Ask which one is driving your experience mod.
Their experts are billable. Ask what the program costs in year two when the services engagement is renewed.

landmines: What happens to the program when the consulting engagement ends?
How many weeks until you see your first finding?
What share of last year's claims were serious injuries versus strains and sprains?

products.name: Lumenfield SIF Platform
products.description: High-energy hazard detection and precursor tracking

products.name: Lumenfield Advisory
products.description: Consulting engagements run by former OSHA and EHS leaders

positive.detail: Customers value the consultants more than the software.

negative.detail: Months before the first useful insight.
Services fees grow with each new site.

positive.detail: Trusted founder with deep safety credibility.

negative.detail: Consultants on the road most weeks.
